about_the_game:
Add a touch of warmth to your day with the official Dragon Spot Wallpaper Pack! This DLC includes 10 unique images inspired by the world of dragons, villagers, and serene island landscapes.

By purchasing this pack, you directly support our small development team and help us continue creating amazing games.

Thank you for your kindness and support! 💖
